license_evidence.finding: README says most image resources Apache-2.0, but its linked root LICENSE is SIL OFL 1.1. No LICENSE is present in 3D/png. Gallery FAQ CC BY 4.0 refers to animated assets. Do not assume the 3D PNGs have Apache or CC-BY terms.

font_route_followup.finding: OFL FAQ 1.26 permits AI design tools producing non-font graphical output; 1.25 treats generated font software differently. A dataset rendered from the explicitly OFL-licensed 3D font is a plausible separate route, not a resolution of raw PNG license scope. Fonts are Git LFS pointers and must be fetched/hash-verified before inspecting bitmap resolution and rendering coverage. No Noto assets imported and no claim about unrestricted model-weight licensing.
